svg.title: Two-story house, first and second floor (fictional)

g.text: The hatched rooms are two storeys tall. On the second floor the same area is marked OPEN TO BELOW.
Stairs: 36 in min clear width, 7 3/4 in max riser, 10 in min tread, 6 ft 8 in min headroom (IRC R311.7).
Walls 4 in inside, 8 in outside. Ceiling 9 ft at the first floor, 8 ft at the second.
